title: Business Silver Rewards Card: New Customer First Year Fee Waiver
summary: This document describes the Business Silver Rewards Card offer that waives the first-year annual fee to $0 for new customers who open an account between 2025-11-15 and 2026-01-15. After year one, the standard annual fee is $122.50, and eligibility/waiver can be verified in the cardholder agreement and first statement (contact support if not reflected).
